description: Canonical safe failure-injection recipes for disposable Kilo smoke fixtures.

recipes.purpose: Exercise NOT_DONE → /fix → /verify → /review with an obvious implementation defect.
recipes.injection: Change one tiny deterministic production behavior so an existing focused unit test fails. Prefer an arithmetic/boolean/string transformation defect. Do not alter the test.
recipes.safety: No security, persistence, external service, or destructive behavior.

recipes.purpose: Exercise NOT_DONE → /diagnose → /fix → /verify → /review where the observed symptom does not establish root cause.
recipes.injection: Introduce a small deterministic defect beneath an end-to-end normalization/formatting behavior so the high-level assertion fails but verification output alone cannot prove which internal transformation is responsible.
recipes.safety: Keep the failure deterministic and local; do not use flaky timing or external dependencies.

recipes.purpose: Exercise diagnosis/fix routing in the optional local-persistence fixture.
recipes.injection: Introduce a deterministic mismatch between the approved persistence behavior and the local repository/adapter behavior such that the focused integration test observes the failure but root cause requires inspecting the persistence path.
recipes.safety: Use only embedded/local disposable data. No cloud/external database and no destructive migration.

recipes.purpose: Exercise NOT_DONE → /waive → CLEAR_WITH_EXCEPTION → /review with a bounded low-risk failure.
recipes.injection: Trigger one project-approved waivable non-runtime quality/documentation gate, such as intentionally omitting required public API documentation or a harmless explicitly-waivable lint/documentation condition while behavioral/security checks remain passing.
recipes.safety: Never use auth, authorization, secret scanning, vulnerability, data-integrity, destructive migration, reliability-invariant, or other non-waivable security/safety failures.

recipes.purpose: Prove implementation content changes invalidate reusable verification evidence before reviewers run.
recipes.injection: After fresh verification, change one identity-bearing implementation byte without rerunning verification.

recipes.purpose: Prove effective Git mode/type is part of implementation identity.
recipes.injection: After fresh verification, change only a reliably representable Git mode/type such as 100644 → 100755 without changing content.
expected_route: /review freshness gate: MISMATCH, or UNRECONSTRUCTABLE when platform cannot represent/determine mode reliably
recipes.safety: Use a disposable tracked file. Do not fake unsupported Windows filesystem semantics; use WSL only when intentionally available.

recipes.purpose: Prove verification cannot CLEAR a repository state that changes during checks.
recipes.injection: Configure or use a disposable verification-side behavior that changes one identity-bearing non-evidence path during verification while the required check itself can otherwise pass.
recipes.safety: Mutation must be local, deterministic, reversible, and restricted to the disposable fixture.

recipes.purpose: Prove malformed or unreconstructable reusable evidence fails closed.
recipes.injection: Use a disposable copied run/verification evidence case with one required reconstruction field missing/malformed, or make the recorded base unavailable in a controlled disposable environment.
recipes.safety: Do not corrupt historical canonical evidence in a non-disposable repository.

recipes.purpose: Prove cheap pre-review blocks senior review and persists Senior Review: NOT_RUN.
recipes.injection: Introduce one small genuine review-only maintainability/project-rule violation not already caught by deterministic verification, such as an explicitly prohibited duplicate implementation pattern or materially misleading API naming.
recipes.safety: Do not create a security defect or weaken deterministic checks merely to force a review finding.
